main_measure.name: in-stretch minus out-of-stretch mean next-bar return
main_measure.threshold: confirm if difference > 0 with Welch t >= 2; reject if difference < 0 with t <= -2; |t| < 2 inconclusive; needs >=100 in-stretch bars, >=100 out-of-stretch bars, >=3 distinct up-cross stretches

supporting_check.name: share of up next-bars in-stretch minus out-of-stretch

decided_by: The Welch t has |t| < 2, which the plan rules inconclusive.
reading: In-stretch and out-of-stretch bars are those with forecast > 0 and forecast = 0 that have a next bar in the same window. A distinct up-cross stretch is each maximal run of raw SMA spread > 0 within a window, including a run already under way at the window's first bar.
